# AI Life / 数字人生 / 虚拟人生

## English
AI Life is a KING AI ecosystem consumer digital-life product focused on persistent relationships, home, career, city, travel, events, possessions, long-term memory and world continuity. This public repository contains product information and customer-safe facts only.

Official ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work
Business & partnership: vip@kingai.work
Public facts: README.md
Business direction: BUSINESS.md
Roadmap: ROADMAP.md

## 中文
AI Life / 数字人生 / 虚拟人生是 KING AI 主生态的消费者数字生命产品，重点是长期关系、家庭、事业、城市、旅行、事件、资产、长期记忆与世界连续性。本公开仓仅包含产品资料与适合客户阅读的公开事实。

官网：https://www.kingai.work
商务与合作：vip@kingai.work
